kanban_board.title: Audit all README claims against implementation
kanban_board.description: Compare every claim in README.md against actual source code: commands, paths, parameters, version, market list, Python versions, dependencies, API surface.
acceptance_criteria: All CLI examples execute without error
Version consistent across pyproject.toml and CLI
Market list matches MARKET_HOSTS in http.py

kanban_board.title: Remove test count from marketing content
kanban_board.description: Ensure test count is not used in tagline, title, repo description, badges, or first-screen README. If retained in testing section, generate from actual suite.
acceptance_criteria: No test count in project tagline or title
No test count in repository description
No test count in first-screen README content
Testing section focuses on what tests protect
kanban_board.source_task: P0.2 Remove test count from marketing

kanban_board.title: Verify packaging (build, install, metadata)
kanban_board.description: Run python -m build, inspect wheel/sdist, verify package files included, entry points work, metadata correct, version consistent, Python requirement accurate.

kanban_board.title: Verify CI configuration
kanban_board.description: Inspect all GitHub Actions. Ensure CI runs tests on supported Python versions, lint/type checks if configured, package/build validation. No oversized matrix for appearance.

kanban_board.title: Replace README with verified target version
kanban_board.description: README already replaced with verified version. Validate every command, file path, example matches current API, remove unsupported examples, ensure claims are factual.
acceptance_criteria: All CLI commands in README execute correctly

kanban_board.title: Improve GitHub repository metadata
kanban_board.description: Review repository description, topics, homepage, social preview, About section. Position as: 'Resilient pure-HTTP Python client for undocumented JobsDB/JobStreet GraphQL backend — sync/async, adaptive rate limiting, SQLite cache, typed failures, contract-drift detection.' Use engineering-focused topics.
acceptance_criteria: Topics include: python, graphql, http-client, async, reliability, reverse-engineering, api-client, automation, sqlite, testing

kanban_board.title: Create engineering case study (docs/CASE_STUDY.md)
kanban_board.description: docs/CASE_STUDY.md exists with structure: Problem, Constraints, Protocol discovery, Architecture, Failure model, Rate limiting, Cache correctness, Contract drift, Sync vs async, Scope reduction, Testing strategy, Trade-offs, Lessons learned, What productionization would require. Explains engineering decisions, not just restates README.

kanban_board.title: Create architecture document (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
kanban_board.description: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md exists with: public API layer, sync client, async client, protocol/request builder, HTTP transport, response classification, rate limiter, cache, contract doctor, domain models, CLI. Explains dependency direction. No diagrams claiming absent abstractions.

kanban_board.title: Create failure matrix (docs/FAILURE_MATRIX.md)
kanban_board.description: docs/FAILURE_MATRIX.md exists with table: Failure class, Detection, Expected behavior, Retry, Test coverage. Filled with verified implementation behavior from http.py and models.py.
acceptance_criteria: Table covers: network, http, blocked, runtime, ok, contract drift
Each cell filled with verified behavior

kanban_board.title: Add Engineering Evidence section to README
kanban_board.description: README includes 'Engineering evidence' table mapping concerns to implementation files: sync client, async client, HTTP/protocol layer, GraphQL queries, models, cache, Markdown renderer, doctor, CLI, tests. Uses actual filenames.
acceptance_criteria: Maps at minimum: sync client, async client, HTTP/protocol, GraphQL queries, models, cache, Markdown renderer, doctor, CLI, tests

kanban_board.title: Verify request construction is shared between sync/async
kanban_board.description: Inspect sync and async implementations. build_search_params is shared in http.py, used by both clients. Filter encoding, GraphQL variables, operation names, market selection, common headers all shared.
acceptance_criteria: Both JobsDBClient and AsyncJobsDBClient use it
Regression tests pass before/after any refactor
kanban_board.source_task: P2.1 Verify request construction is shared

kanban_board.title: Strengthen typed failure semantics
kanban_board.description: Audit failure taxonomy: ok, network, http, runtime, blocked are distinguishable. Verify exceptions/results provide enough info for callers. Tests verify classification of representative failures. Do not over-engineer hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: Five failure classes distinguishable in code
RequestError.kind carries: network, http, blocked, runtime
Exceptions include diagnostic context (status, body snippet, operation)
Tests cover classification of each failure type

kanban_board.title: Audit and document retry behavior
kanban_board.description: Document and test: retryable network failures, retryable HTTP statuses, non-retryable statuses, blocked responses, max attempts, backoff, interaction with rate limiter. No retry on blocked. No retry everything.
acceptance_criteria: Network failures (timeout, connection refused, DNS) retry with exponential backoff
Soft GraphQL error (UNSTABLE_QUERY_ERROR) retries once with new sessionId

kanban_board.title: Audit adaptive rate limiter
kanban_board.description: Verify: initial interval, minimum interval, maximum interval, pressure signal (seek-bot-score), increase behavior (×1.5, cap 3×), recovery behavior (÷1.2), concurrency interaction. Add deterministic unit tests without real network.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic unit tests exist (no real network)

kanban_board.title: Audit SQLite cache correctness
kanban_board.description: Verify: cache key (job_id, market), stored payload, content hash (SHA-1), cache hit, cache miss, stale/invalid entry, overwrite, concurrent access assumptions, serialization failures. Tests for: missing, valid, changed, corrupt, expired (if TTL exists). No TTL claimed if none exists.
acceptance_criteria: SHA-1 of description content stored with payload
get_valid() returns cached row only when hash matches
No TTL - staleness by content change only
Tests cover: missing, valid, changed, corrupt

kanban_board.title: Audit async bounded concurrency
kanban_board.description: Verify bulk detail fetching: hard concurrency bound (Semaphore), no unbounded task set, individual failures handled, result association with IDs preserved, resources closed correctly. Add deterministic concurrency tests.
acceptance_criteria: Individual job failures don't cancel others

kanban_board.title: Strengthen jobsdb doctor checks and output
kanban_board.description: Doctor already has: 7 checks (search.basic, search.fields, search.facets, search.salary_filter, detail.payload, facets.v6_titles, facets.v6_locations), human-readable summary with PASS/FAIL, Contract status: HEALTHY/DRIFT DETECTED. Failures show expected vs observed.
acceptance_criteria: Failure detail shows expected vs observed

kanban_board.title: Make doctor exit codes meaningful
kanban_board.description: cli.py cmd_doctor returns 0 if healthy, 1 if drift detected. Allows automation. CI does not depend on live service.
acceptance_criteria: jobsdb doctor exits 0 on healthy contract
jobsdb doctor exits 1 on drift detected
CI does not run doctor (or is optional)
kanban_board.source_task: P3.2 Make doctor exit codes meaningful

kanban_board.title: Add machine-readable doctor output (--json)
kanban_board.description: Doctor CLI supports --json flag. Output stable schema with status and checks array. DoctorReport.to_dict() implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Output includes checks array with name, status, detail

kanban_board.title: Keep tests offline (enforce)
kanban_board.description: Default test suite has no live JobsDB/JobStreet dependency, no credentials, no browser, no external network. Live checks belong to doctor.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor is separate from test suite

kanban_board.title: Identify and add missing high-value tests
kanban_board.description: Audit test coverage gaps. Prioritize tests around invariants: Protocol (filter encoding, salary encoding, pagination, operation selection, market routing), Failure (network, HTTP, blocked, malformed, runtime parser), Cache (hit, miss, validation, persistence), Rate limiting (pressure increases interval, recovery, limits respected), Async (bounded concurrency, per-job failure isolation, cleanup), Markdown (headings, links, lists, nested, malformed/empty HTML).
acceptance_criteria: Failure classification tests cover all 5 classes
Markdown renderer edge case tests added

kanban_board.title: Test properties not just examples
kanban_board.description: Where useful, test invariants: encoding then parsing preserves semantics, pagination doesn't duplicate jobs, cache validation detects content changes, concurrency never exceeds bound. No property-based testing unless meaningful value.
acceptance_criteria: Property-style tests added for key invariants
kanban_board.source_task: P4.3 Test properties not just examples

kanban_board.title: Add benchmarks if meaningful engineering evidence
kanban_board.description: Only if useful: cold cache vs warm cache, sequential vs bounded concurrency detail retrieval. Benchmark against fixtures/mocks, not real upstream. Document machine/environment. Create docs/BENCHMARKS.md only if results meaningful.
acceptance_criteria: No synthetic results presented as production performance

kanban_board.title: Audit SECURITY.md and TERMS_OF_USE.md
kanban_board.description: Ensure they accurately describe current guest-only scope. README clearly states: not official SEEK SDK, upstream undocumented/private, no credential automation, no account mutation, users responsible for applicable terms.
acceptance_criteria: README states: not official SEEK SDK
README states: user responsibility for terms
kanban_board.source_task: P6.1 Audit security and legal presentation

kanban_board.title: Document AI-assisted development professionally
kanban_board.description: README includes AI-assisted development section: AI used for implementation/research acceleration, generated code reviewed, tests/CI provide verification, architecture and final decisions human-controlled. Not 'AI wrote the repository'.
acceptance_criteria: States AI used for acceleration across activities
Does not claim 'AI wrote the repository'

kanban_board.title: GitHub issue templates
kanban_board.description: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ exists with templates for bug, upstream contract change, feature request. Upstream-change template collects: date, market, operation, observed failure, expected behavior, doctor output.

kanban_board.title: Pull request template
kanban_board.description: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md exists with: What changed?, Why?, Tests?, Contract impact?, Security impact?, Documentation updated?

kanban_board.title: Release notes / CHANGELOG
kanban_board.description: CHANGELOG.md exists. Releases should explain: breaking changes, protocol changes, compatibility, test coverage changes, security/scope changes. Avoid generic AI-generated prose.

kanban_board.title: Ensure excluded features are NOT implemented
kanban_board.description: Verify none of: login, credential storage, cookie harvesting, authenticated profile APIs, automated job applications, automated saves/bookmarks, CAPTCHA solving, aggressive anti-bot bypass, unbounded concurrency, unrestricted request flooding, fake production benchmarks, fake live demos, LLM features for portfolio optics.
